meta.title: Implement unbound dns caching
meta.body_summary: Integrate Unbound DNS caching into the HaxUnit Docker container to improve DNS resolution performance for reconnaissance tools.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor added Unbound DNS caching to the HaxUnit Docker container; x-stp provided extensive review comments on systemd, security, kernel tuning, and silent failures; PR remains open awaiting these changes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 686 changed lines across 9 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, adding configuration, scripts, and documentation for Unbound DNS caching. As a feature PR, it is currently open with unresolved review feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer x-stp flagged that Unbound startup lacks proper process supervision (systemd), silent failure handling, missing private network firewall, and missing kernel parameter tuning for high-load DNS caching.
review_details.performance_claim: Faster subdomain enumeration and DNS lookups via local Unbound caching.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Integrating Unbound DNS caching requires deep infrastructure knowledge: systemd process supervision, kernel parameter tuning (sysctl), firewall configuration for private networks, and optimal cache sizing. Cursor provided a basic configuration but missed these system-level concerns, as highlighted by the reviewer.

detection_detail.code_reading: x-stp performed a thorough review of the shell scripts and Unbound configuration, pointing out missing systemd service, private network firewall, sysctl tweaks, and proper failure handling.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or timing evidence provided; PR body lacks numeric performance claims or reproduction steps.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression was reported; the PR is still open and has not introduced regressions.

core_change_summary.description: Added Unbound DNS resolver integration via configuration (unbound.conf), startup script (start-unbound.sh), monitoring script (dns-monitor.sh), and test script (test-dns-cache.sh). Modified Dockerfile to install unbound and dnsutils, updated docker-entrypoint.sh to handle Unbound startup under set -e, and updated main.py to use localhost DNS resolution (127.0.0.1).
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation file DNS_CACHING_README.md contains architectural overview and usage notes; docker-compose.yml adds a comment about DNS cache.
change_trajectory: Single commit implementing Unbound DNS caching with configuration, scripts, Docker integration, and documentation.

review_signals.summary: BugBot flagged that DNS resolution hardcodes 127.0.0.1 and the entrypoint proceeds even if Unbound fails to start, risking silent failures.
Suspected extreme CPU overhead from enabling hardening options like DNSSEC validation and query minimization; will check and bump.
Questioned whether installing dnsutils package is necessary.
Demanded 'exit 1' instead of just print_warning in dns-monitor.sh when Unbound is not running.
Suggested using systemd service for Unbound with health check/retries and a .service file.
Requested SSRF protection for RFC 1918, 1122, 4192, 4193, 4291, 6598, and 3927 in Unbound access-control.
Noted that sysctl.conf may need additional tweaks (file descriptors, buffers) beyond Unbound configuration for high-load caching.
Summarized four major issues: missing systemd watchdog, silent failure handling, missing firewall for private nets, and kernel I/O bottleneck.
